Container.Name: Homelabarr - Backend
Container.Overview: A beautiful, modern web interface for managing your home lab Docker containers. Homelabarr makes it easy to deploy and manage self-hosted applications with just a few clicks. [br] This is the backend component of the Homelabarr stack. It is designed to be used with the Homelabarr Frontend and Homelabarr Socket Proxy containers.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: home lab docker containers management gui web interface deploy
Container.Changes:
### 2026-11-04
Updated for Homelabarr 2.6: new ports and settings, secrets, a dedicated socket proxy, and plain-HTTP login on the LAN.
### 2025-02-02
Initial release
Container.Requires: Install all three Homelabarr templates: Socket Proxy, Backend and Frontend. Create their network once from the Unraid terminal: docker network create homelabarr

Config.Name: Dashboard address
Config.Description: The address you open Homelabarr at, exactly as typed in the browser, for example http://192.168.1.10:8084

Config.Name: Allow plain HTTP
Config.Description: Set to true if you open Homelabarr at a plain http:// address on your LAN (the usual Unraid setup). Without it the browser drops the login cookie and you land back on the login screen. Set to false behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the first login as admin. Change it from the dashboard after logging in.

Config.Name: Session signing key
Config.Description: Random value of at least 32 characters. Generate one in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Database encryption key
Config.Description: Random value of at least 32 characters that encrypts the database. Keep a copy: the database cannot be opened without it. Generate one in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Docker endpoint
Config.Description: Where the backend reaches Docker: the Homelabarr Socket Proxy. Not recommended to change.

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Node environment. Not recommended to change.

Config.Name: Internal API Port
Config.Description: Internal API port. Not recommended to change.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy hops
Config.Description: Number of proxies in front of the backend (the frontend is one). Not recommended to change.
